name: KENT Gold+
summary: KENT Gold Plus Gravity Water Purifier is a non-electric UF water purifier designed for tap and municipal low TDS water. Equipped with a 0.1-micron hollow fibre UF membrane , it removes bacteria, cysts, and suspended impurities without using chemicals, while preserving essential natural minerals.
intro: The KENT Gold Plus Gravity Water Purifier is a premium non-electric, gravity-based water purification system designed to provide safe, hygienic, and great-tasting drinking water without the need for electricity. Ideal for homes, offices, schools, and areas with frequent power cuts, it utilizes Advanced Ultra Filtration (UF) Technology featuring a hollow fibre hydrophilic UF membrane with an ultra-fine pore size of 0.1 microns.
features: Advanced UF Purification Technology with 0.1-micron hollow fibre hydrophilic membrane.
